name: Feero Ironhand
summary: At Maestra's Post, Feero Ironhand guards the road between Darkshore and Ashenvale. He works with Delgren the Purifier against the Cult of the Dark Strand.

sections.title: A Bulwark at Maestra's Post
sections.body: Maestra's Post watches the road south from Darkshore into Ashenvale. Feero Ironhand serves at the outpost, keeping communication and trade with Auberdine moving while watching the surrounding woods. He and Delgren the Purifier oppose the Cult of the Dark Strand. Cultists and forest predators threaten the path between Darnassus's supply lines and Ashenvale's front lines.

faq.answer: Feero Ironhand is an Alliance human paladin at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale. He helps travelers on the road between Darkshore and Ashenvale and coordinates logistics with Auberdine.

faq.q: What is Feero's purpose at Maestra's Post?
faq.answer: Feero helps defend Maestra's Post against local threats. He supports Delgren the Purifier against the Cult of the Dark Strand and helps keep courier and supply routes into Darkshore open.

faq.q: What is the Cult of the Dark Strand?
faq.answer: The Cult of the Dark Strand operates in northern Ashenvale, practicing dark magic and foul rituals. Alliance forces at Maestra's Post work to disrupt and dismantle its operations.

faq.q: Does Feero have connections to the Argent Dawn?
faq.answer: No connection to the Argent Dawn is recorded for Feero. He is a paladin who works closely with Delgren the Purifier, a fellow human paladin fighting dark forces in the forest.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers heading south from Darkshore, Feero offers a foothold in Ashenvale's dangerous, contested wilderness.
As a human, seeing Feero stand guard in Ashenvale's ancient elven woods is a welcome sign of the Alliance working across its peoples.
